Usage: [command] [-h|--help] [--version]

Commands:
  bot create            Create a bot managed by BotFather.
  bot list              List bots owned by the current account.
  bot remove            Remove a bot through BotFather's delete flow.
  bot token             Print or revoke the token for a bot managed by the current account.
  bot write             Send a message to a bot and optionally press an inline UI button.
  channel comments      Export comments for one channel post or for all fetched channel posts.
  channel metrics       Export per-post channel metrics and optional aggregates.
  chat context          Return messages around a target and optionally follow its reply chain.
  chat export           Export chat history to Markdown, JSONL, or TSV; add --transcribe for embedded speech-to-text.
  chat list             List chats from the main chat list.
  chat messages         Print messages from a chat.
  chat migrations       Inspect the complete basic-group to supergroup migration chain.
  chat resolve          Resolve a public username to a chat.
  chat search           Search messages inside a chat.
  chat stats            Print chat boundary and aggregate statistics.
  diagnostics           Print machine-readable session, TDLib, account, database, and network diagnostics.
  download              Download a Telegram file by message, file id, or remote file id.
  download-batch        Download many message attachments concurrently through one TDLib client.
  forum topics          List forum topics in a supergroup.
  link message          Build Telegram links for a message.
  login                 Sign in to Telegram and persist the local TDLib session.
  mcp                   Run a local MCP server over stdin/stdout. Login separately before using Telegram tools.
  mcp install           Install tgcli MCP in all detected local clients of a family: claude, codex or copilot.
  message get           Get one full message as JSON, including extracted files and links.
  message transcribe    Download and transcribe a Telegram voice note, video note, audio or video attachment locally.
  search                Search chats by title or username.
  session export        Export the current Telegram authorization state as a compact secret.
  session import        Import a Telegram authorization secret from stdin.
  session status        Inspect the TDLib session lock without opening Telegram.
  session unlock        Remove stale lock-owner metadata. Refuses while any process owns the OS lock.
  transcribe            Transcribe a local audio or video file using the embedded multilingual Whisper model.

Usage: chat messages [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Print messages from a chat.

Options:
  --chat-id <long>            Chat id from tgcli chat list/search/resolve. [Required]
  --topic-id <int>            Forum topic id. Use tgcli forum topics to list ids. [Default: 0]
  --limit <int>               Maximum messages for a single page. [Default: 30]
  --from-message-id <long>    Start before this message id. Use the oldest printed id as the next page cursor. [Default: 0]
  --offset <int>              TDLib history offset, usually 0. [Default: 0]
  --local                     Read local database only.
  --all                       Fetch all pages until history ends or max-pages is reached.
  --max-pages <int>           Maximum pages to fetch with --all. [Default: 1000]
  --service-only              
  --kind <string?>             [Default: null]
  --format <string>           Output format: tsv, jsonl, md. [Default: @"tsv"]
  --schema <string>           JSON/JSONL schema: simple or rich. [Default: @"simple"]
  --request-timeout <int>      [Default: 60]
  --lock-timeout <int>         [Default: 30]
  --no-wait                   
  --session <string?>         Session directory. Defaults to ~/.local/share/tgcli. [Default: null]

Transcribe a local audio or video file using the embedded multilingual Whisper model.

Options:

  --language <string>    Speech language code, for example uk or en; auto detects the language. [Default: @"auto"]
  --format <string>      Output format: json (with timestamped segments), jsonl or plain. [Default: @"json"]
